name: bank-docs-copilot
description: MCP-free retrieval tools for GitHub Copilot: look up specs, generated code maps and spec-to-code locations instead of dumping files into context.

bankDocs.docsRepoPath.description: Path to the OKF docs bundle (absolute or relative to the first workspace folder).

bankDocs.generatedPaths.description: Folders containing generated code maps (BE/FE), absolute or relative to workspace folders.

bankDocs.maxResultChars.description: Hard cap on characters returned by any tool call (token budget).

bankDocs.graphPath.description: Path to graph.json from scripts/gen-graph.ps1. Empty = <docsRepoPath>/generated/graph/graph.json.

chatParticipants.name: docs
chatParticipants.description: Answer from specs and generated maps; cite spec IDs and file:line

commands.name: spec
commands.description: Find and summarise a spec/calculation by ID or keywords

commands.name: where
commands.description: Where is a spec ID implemented (BE/FE)?

commands.name: impact
commands.description: Blast radius of a change across BE/FE/docs

languageModelTools.name: bank-docs_docsLookup
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the OKF docs bundle (index.md files first, then concept frontmatter) for a spec ID, calculation ID or keywords. Returns matching concept paths, type, status, trust badge and the first section of the best match. Use before reading any source code.

query.description: Spec ID (HEDGE-001), calculation ID (hedge_monthly_cashflow) or 2-5 keywords

section.description: Optional heading to return instead of the first section, e.g. 'Business rules' or 'Computation'

languageModelTools.name: bank-docs_codeMap
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return rows from the generated code maps (api-index, events, db-schema, codebase-map, routes, types-index) that match a query. Cheap alternative to searching or opening source files. Returns table rows with file:line locations.

query.description: Path fragment, topic, table, module, component or symbol

languageModelTools.name: bank-docs_specToCode
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Resolve a spec or calculation ID to the exact code locations tagged with @docs <ID> in the BE and FE repos (from docs-tags.md). Returns declaration, summary and file:line so only those ranges need to be opened.

languageModelTools.name: bank-docs_impact
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Blast radius of a change using the generated architectural graph (modules, endpoints, classes, Kafka topics, tables, FE features/routes, spec IDs). Input a node id (endpoint:GET /api/v1/..., topic:..., table:..., spec:HEDGE-001, class:HedgeFacade, feature:hedges), a substring, or a changed file path. Returns neighbours by depth, the edges, and the spec IDs affected. Use for impact analysis, Jira subtask scoping and test-case scoping instead of searching the code.

target.description: Graph node id, substring, or repo-relative file path
